name: outputs.Setups.BirchSgd.Params.mk.noConfusion
type_text:
{P : Sort u} →
  {d : ℕ} →
    {L σ ε Δ R : ℝ} →
      {x0 : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d} →
        {tree : outputs.Algorithms.BirchSgd.Tree} →
          {branch : ℕ → ℕ} →
            {d' : ℕ} →
              {L' σ' ε' Δ' R' : ℝ} →
                {x0' : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d'} →
                  {tree' : outputs.Algorithms.BirchSgd.Tree} →
                    {branch' : ℕ → ℕ} →
                      { d := d, L := L, σ := σ, ε := ε, Δ := Δ, R := R, x0 := x0, tree := tree, branch := branch } =
                          { d := d', L := L', σ := σ', ε := ε', Δ := Δ', R := R', x0 := x0', tree := tree',
                            branch := branch' } →
                        (d = d' →
                            L = L' →
                              σ = σ' → ε = ε' → Δ = Δ' → R = R' → x0 ≍ x0' → tree = tree' → branch = branch' → P) →
                          P
